title: Advanced Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning
tagline: Kernel methods, probabilistic graphical models, EM, HMM/CRF, evolutionary optimisation, causal ML, federated/transfer/active/online/continual/meta-learning, AutoML and the full reinforcement-learning stack.

topics.title: Kernels and probabilistic models
topics.summary: Kernel methods, latent-variable models, sequence models and graphical models.
items: Kernel methods, Mercer kernels, RKHS, representer theorem, kernel ridge
Gaussian processes (regression and classification), kernel design
Expectation-Maximisation and Gaussian mixture derivation
Hidden Markov Models: forward, Viterbi, Baum-Welch
Conditional Random Fields for sequence labelling
Bayesian networks, d-separation, Markov random fields
Probabilistic graphical models: exact and approximate inference, structure learning
Monte Carlo, importance sampling, MCMC (MH, Gibbs, HMC)
Variational inference and the ELBO
questions: Derive the E-step and M-step for a GMM.
Forward vs reverse KL in variational inference?

topics.title: Evolutionary computation and metaheuristics
topics.summary: Gradient-free global optimisation for hard, non-differentiable problems.
items: Genetic Algorithms: selection, crossover, mutation, elitism
Particle Swarm Optimisation
Ant Colony Optimisation
Simulated Annealing
Differential Evolution and CMA-ES
Multi-objective optimisation: Pareto dominance, NSGA-II, hypervolume
Benchmarking metaheuristics (30 runs, Wilcoxon/Friedman)
Metaheuristics for feature selection and hyper-parameter search
questions: Why does a weighted sum miss non-convex Pareto fronts?

topics.title: Learning paradigms beyond supervised learning
topics.summary: Causal, federated, transfer, active, online, continual, meta-learning and AutoML.
items: Causal inference: potential outcomes, DAGs, do-calculus, propensity scores
Causal ML: meta-learners, causal forests, double ML, uplift modelling
Federated learning: FedAvg, non-IID, FedProx, secure aggregation
Differential privacy and DP-SGD
Transfer learning and fine-tuning strategies
Semi-supervised learning: pseudo-labels, consistency regularisation
Active learning: uncertainty, query-by-committee, core-set
Online learning, regret, bandits, concept drift
Continual learning: EWC, replay, forgetting metrics
Meta-learning: MAML, prototypical networks
AutoML and Neural Architecture Search
questions: Why isn't a lasso-selected feature a cause?
Why does non-IID data slow FedAvg?
Explain MAML's inner and outer loops.
resources: Advances and Open Problems in Federated Learning (Kairouz et al.)

topics.title: Reinforcement learning
topics.summary: MDPs to PPO and SAC: theory, algorithms and practical recipes.
items: Markov decision processes, returns, value functions
Bellman expectation and optimality equations
Dynamic programming: policy evaluation, policy iteration, value iteration
Monte Carlo methods and temporal-difference learning, TD(lambda)
SARSA and Q-learning, exploration strategies
Function approximation and the deadly triad
DQN, Double DQN, Dueling, Prioritised replay, Rainbow
Policy gradient, REINFORCE, baselines, GAE
Actor-Critic, A2C/A3C, TRPO, PPO
DDPG, TD3, SAC (maximum-entropy RL)
Model-based RL, imitation and offline RL overview
questions: SARSA vs Q-learning on the cliff-walking task?
Why does PPO clip the probability ratio?
What does SAC's entropy term achieve?
